title: Cosmic Neural Flower Orb
description: A glowing, intricate glass orb sits on an ornate metallic stand against a swirling cosmic background. Inside the transparent sphere, a vibrant surreal composition features a central pink flower connected by glowing blue neural-like pathways to purple trumpet flowers, a large yellow spiral, and various other blossoms and fleur-de-lis symbols.
prompt: A large transparent glass orb on an ornate dark metal stand contains a surreal glowing botanical neural network. A central pink flower connects via bright blue luminous pathways to purple trumpet flowers, a vibrant yellow spiral pattern, smaller blossoms, and fleur-de-lis symbols. The orb floats in a dark cosmic space with swirling red and grey nebulae, stars, and floating fleur-de-lis motifs.
